title: gnssguard: GNSS interference detection from open ADS-B data
description:
Detects GPS jamming and spoofing that affects aircraft from free, open ADS-B flight data (adsb.lol), in 1-degree cells and 15-minute windows, and publishes a nightly map and open data files: https://sahilprg.github.io/gnss-interference/

Every evaluation is declared in docs/evaluation_protocol.md before its data is seen; failed checks are published. Sealed test (250 hand-labelled cells, 5-18 Nov 2026; protocol and scoring code archived before the draw, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24073541): the learned model found 56% of interference, a one-line integrity rule 74%, with near-zero false alarms for both; the model failed its declared gate. Since 0.3.0 the published label comes from the rules plus that integrity rule, tested again on 1-14 Dec 2026 as declared in advance. See CHANGELOG.md for what each version changes.

Research project. Not for navigation or operational decisions. Code: MIT. Derived data: ODbL 1.0 (DATA_LICENSE.md).
notes: Input data: adsb.lol open data archive (ODbL 1.0). Map background: Natural Earth (public domain).
